content: Kept the new config types on the unstable surface instead of promoting them into the stable API. Preferred deleting the redundant knip entry over suppressing the warning, so the config graph stays honest.
Working tree changes are not committed yet.
TASK-010 closes the statemachine lint/typecheck gate cleanup: export visibility for config types and knip config honesty.

Re-exported `ValidationConfig` and `MonitoringConfig` from `src/index.ts` on the unstable surface so API extraction sees the config types that are part of the package contract. Removed the redundant `src/index.ts` entry from `knip.json` so knip uses the actual project glob without double-counting the package entrypoint. Regenerated `etc/statemachine.api.md` after the export fix.
UR-001: Add mandatory lint and typecheck gates for the statemachine package.
